implementation_commit.message: fix(P10): harden probe join and receipt retry paths

review_scope.scope: Complete P10 Controller/Agent probe, receipt, activation, provider-result, and persistence diff was inspected against the P10 plan and frozen protocol/state contracts.
review_scope.bounded_fix_decision: The only additional proven defect found during this review was the Agent retry gate: ReceiptSent records a transport write, not the Controller semantic acknowledgement. Consumed receipts must therefore be retried after reconnect while the tombstone remains. No speculative Controller refactor was retained.
review_scope.reverted_experiment: A payload-derived envelope message-ID rejection was tested and reverted because the frozen transport contract specifies same-message-ID dedup/conflict semantics rather than requiring derivation, and existing probe-sink tests intentionally use arbitrary valid envelope IDs.

repair_findings_addressed.change: Manager.Arm rejects node/forward mismatches and non-current forward activations before creating work; CreateProbeOperationBundle repeats the node/current-activation check inside the transaction as the race fence.
SetProbeOperationChallenge rejects empty and non-hex text and stores a canonical lowercase value; the join boundary still requires a protocol-sized digest.
PublishProbeJoin requires the authenticated node public key and verifies ACK1 and RCT1 Ed25519 signatures, bindings, evidence completeness, and the legal snapshot before the status CAS.

Probe ingress receipts use a durable semantic operation binding; sink failure leaves the inbox RECEIVED so a duplicate can retry, processed rows suppress duplicate forwarding, and the Agent now retries consumed receipts even when the prior transport write set ReceiptSent=true.
The Agent durable RCT1 tombstone stores the payload digest used by the Controller semantic receipt, while accepting legacy envelope-id rows only when their receipt bytes derive the same digest.
Exact duplicate provider/WAN/ACK/RCT evidence is idempotent; conflicting evidence remains rejected, so an RCT1 retry cannot terminalize a live operation.
